commands.command: echo '=== IDENTITY ==='; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('Makefile')
text = p.read_text()
old_jobs = 'HOST_BUILD_JOBS ?= 2'
old_run = 'RUN_IDF := bash scripts/run_idf.sh\n'
if text.count(old_jobs) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected one {old_jobs!r}, found {text.count(old_jobs)}')
if text.count(old_run) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected one RUN_IDF line, found {text.count(old_run)}')
text = text.replace(old_jobs, 'HOST_BUILD_JOBS ?= 4', 1)
text = text.replace(old_run, old_run + 'IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE ?= 1\nexport IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE\n', 1)
p.write_text(text)
PY
git diff --check
echo '=== PERF_ENV ==='; make --no-print-directory -s --eval 'print-perf-env: ; @printf "IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE=%s HOST_BUILD_JOBS=%s\n" "$$IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE" "$(HOST_BUILD_JOBS)"' print-perf-env
